race.comment: FULLY FUNDED (5) keeps running you honest races without gaining that victory. She has been getting closer each time too. Now they add the blinkers by themselves for the first time. Can take up a position and prove to be the one. KINKY MISTRESS (7) went so much better her second time around. She can use the barrier to advantage and run well here again. SNOWY MOUNTAINS (13) has her own gear changes to lift off what was a stronger effort three weeks back. Longer races will help her. NINETYFIVEINAFIFTY (8) has shown consistency without looking like winning. Can certainly place again. PRINCESS PRUSSIA (9) resumes off two trials. Would be no surprise to see her go OK at the home track. Barrier does hurt.
